card.label: H.R. 2481
card.summary: The Romance Scam Prevention Act requires online dating service providers to send a fraud ban notification to any user who has exchanged messages with an account that has been banned for suspected fraud. The law establishes standard rules for what these notifications must contain, how quickly they must be sent, and provides a legal safe harbor for companies complying with the requirement. It also sets up federal and state enforcement mechanisms through the Federal Trade Commission and state attorneys general, while establishing a single national standard that overrides state-level notification laws.
